title: Orange effective configuration provenance (version 2)
description: recording_snapshot_start.json session.effective_configuration: the app configuration file as loaded (path, SHA-256 of its exact bytes, size, contents), every ORANGE_* variable present at record start with its source (the real environment, or the app-config bridge), and a short list of process-shaping variables; secret-looking names are redacted. Written by BuildEffectiveConfiguration (src/effective_configuration.cpp) and checked by ValidateEmittedEffectiveConfiguration. v2 adopts agent-contracts orange-palette/digest_form_v1: app_config.sha256 is a token sha256:<64 hex>; v1 (no published schema) wrote bare hex, nothing else differs. Orange never reads the block back. contents is the app config file verbatim and stays open.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's exact bytes; set for loaded and invalid_json, null otherwise.

contents.description: The parsed file when status is loaded, else null.
